items.title: Prevent post-DONE activity heartbeat from recreating removed story worktree directories
items.context: story_advance DONE runs git worktree remove, then the same process writes an activity heartbeat using the old (now-removed) worktree path as cwd, recreating an orphan directory containing only docs/story/activity.jsonl. Analyze and fix: either flush all activity heartbeat writes before git worktree remove, or detect a removed cwd worktree before the heartbeat write and redirect to the main repo path, or chdir back to the main repo at the start of DONE cleanup. Analysis-only backlog — does not block main; koala doctor detects the orphans and manual rm clears them.
items.userSees: After story_advance DONE, koala doctor --format=json shows "orphanDirs":[] and the removed story worktree path does not exist; final activity is written under the main repo .koala/activity.jsonl.

happy.desc: story_advance DONE redirects the final activity heartbeat to the main repo when the starting worktree has been removed.

edge.desc: A DONE command invoked from the story worktree does not recreate .worktrees/<storyId> after cleanup.

adversarial.desc: The test fails if a ghost worktree shell containing runtime activity logs appears after DONE cleanup.
